records.footnote: Statistics on R&D Manpower (FTE) are compiled based on the findings of the National Survey of Research, Innovation and Enterprise (RIE).  R&D researchers comprise of research scientist and engineers (RSEs), full-time post-graduate research students (only applicable for institutes of higher learning and public research institutes) and non-degree researchers.  Full time equivalent (FTE) refers to manpower in terms of full-time equivalent years.  The population data (denominator) used to derive this indicator is based on Singapore's total population.  For latest data on population, please refer to the table titled 'Indicators On Population, Annual' (https://tablebuilder.singstat.gov.sg/table/TS/M810001).  Data are used for SDG 9.5.2 'Researchers (in full-time equivalent) per million inhabitants'.  Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 9.5.2.
